description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who evaluated various criteria within a generative-AI-driven claim retrieval system. The vertical axis, labeled “Criterion,” lists six distinct evaluation categories in descending order of participant count: “FC Summary” (top), “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation” (bottom). The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” represents the count on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each bar’s length corresponds to the number of participants who rated that criterion, with exact values indicated by numbers at the end of each bar: “FC Summary” has a value of 6, “Relevance Explanation” has 5, “Clarity and Simplicity” has 3, “Overall Summary” has 2, “Filters” has 1, and “Veracity Explanation” has 1. The bars are colored differently for distinction: “FC Summary” is dark purple, “Relevance Explanation” is dark teal, “Clarity and Simplicity” is medium teal, “Overall Summary” is green, “Filters” is light green, and “Veracity Explanation” is olive green. The bars are arranged in descending order of participant count, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color-coding and numerical labeling.
